verdict.rationale: The evidence shows annual-report deadline reminders, compliance-status notifications and AI-generated meeting minutes. None of these is a documented way to hand an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input. The llms.txt file is guidance for AI crawlers, not an interface agents can act through. These are adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
